title: HTV-X1: Japan's next-generation ISS cargo ship

research.what: JAXA formally began the HTV-X project to develop a cheaper, higher-capacity successor to the HTV (Kounotori). The new design has a separate service module, external unpressurised cargo and a post-mission technology-demonstration phase. Origin: JAXA HTV-X development project, formally initiated in 2017 (building on the HTV, first flown 2009), with Mitsubishi Heavy Industries

change.what: HTV-X1 launched on 26 October 2025 on the first H3-24W rocket and berthed at the ISS. It delivered cargo and later deployed a satellite after leaving the station.

note: This is Japan's new ISS logistics vehicle and is designed to serve later Gateway lunar resupply. It cuts late-cargo loading time from 80 hours to 24.

refs.label: Space Voyaging: New JAXA HTV-X launched for the first time

security.note: Autonomous rendezvous and command links to a crewed station are safety-critical, so the vehicle's command and control systems need strong integrity protections.
